acceptance_predicates.description: Every configuration option and individual setting is represented in a machine-readable registry derived from the ASB data model, including agent, provider, model, authentication/API-key reference, tool, workload, benchmark, monitor, measure, defaults, and execution options.
Each registered field identifies its owning Rust type/module and logical name without exposing secret values.
A generated registry test fails when a supported data-model field is not documented or is documented with an invalid storage/flow classification.

definition_of_done: ASB can emit a complete, secret-free data-model inventory that downstream extraction stages consume instead of maintaining a hand-written list.

inputs.description: ASB configuration, plan, selection, catalog, and result data types.
AR-1842 logical-name selection and internal identity contract.

outputs.description: Versioned machine-readable field/entity registry with ownership and sensitivity metadata.

gates.description: Registry coverage and secret-redaction tests pass for every supported configuration field.
